subject: Renewal negotiation — OptiWare RFP and benchmark follow-up
messages:
From: Caroline Liu <caroline@optiware.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Clarke <morgan.clarke@optiware.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OptiWare RFP v3 & benchmark schedule

Hi Neha / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking our RFP. We're running a short competitive evaluation (Redwood vs AtlasAI vs an internal prototype) and we want to make sure the bake-off is apples-to-apples. Attached is OptiWare_RFP_v3.pdf with sections on throughput, latency, and data handling. High-level asks: 

- Target sustained throughput: ~500k tokens/day with daily bursts to 1.2M tokens
- Latency target: p50 < 150ms for our 512-token median snippet (p95 tolerance up to 400ms)
- Cost target: ideally < $0.003/token for steady-state at scale
- Security: SOC2 evidence + audit logs required for procurement review

We plan to run a 5-day bake-off the week of Mar 2. Can Redwood provision a test environment (hosted or dedicated POC) and run our test payload? Please confirm the resources you need and whether you'll supply any benchmarking scripts/metrics so we can compare fairly.

Also, for transparency: AtlasAI has provided a preliminary capacity quote that looks ~20% below Redwood's published list price. That won't be the only factor, but procurement flagged price as a gating item.

Attaching: OptiWare_RFP_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Caroline Liu
Head of Platform Ops, OptiWare
caroline@optiware.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Liu <caroline@optiware.com>, Morgan Clarke <morgan.clarke@optiware.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptiWare RFP v3 & benchmark schedule

Caroline, Morgan —

Really appreciate the clear RFP. We can absolutely run a controlled bake-off and surface the performance/cost tradeoffs for you. Proposed plan: 

1) Kickoff call to align on metrics, dataset slices, traffic profile — Tue Feb 24 or Wed Feb 25 (30 min)
2) Redwood to provision a short-lived Dedicated POC with identical model family and quantization profile; we will also run a hosted parallel test for a comparison.
3) We will run your test payload (please send it) and provide: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost per 1k tokens, and a transcript of any model differences.

Questions: 
- Can you share the test payload, and which user flows (chat, summarization, rerank) we should prioritize?
- Does procurement need SOC2 artifact pages in advance, or during the bake-off?

I've attached a small sample payload that mirrors the sections in your RFP so we can start pre-warming. If AtlasAI surfaced a lower price, we can design a committed-capacity option to tighten economics — I want to avoid surprises for Procurement.

Proposed stakeholders on our side: Marcus (technical lead), Rishi (commercial lead), myself.

Thanks — looking forward to lining up the kickoff.

Attachments: optiware_test_payload.jsonl

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Morgan Clarke <morgan.clarke@optiware.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Caroline Liu <caroline@optiware.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@optifware.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptiWare RFP v3 & benchmark schedule

Neha —

Thanks for the quick response and sample payload. We're prioritizing three flows: 
- user-chat (low latency, short tokens)
- document-summarization (longer contexts up to 2k tokens)
- reranking (batch, throughput-sensitive)

Attached is a larger test bundle. Procurement (Sam) asked me to flag price again — AtlasAI submitted a 12-month committed quote that ends up ~18-22% lower in our model than Redwood's public list. We're still evaluating reliability and SLAs, but cost is the main gating item if performance is comparable.

We'd like a kickoff demo and proposal by Mar 2 so we can plan the bake-off that week. Any chance you can share a preliminary committed-capacity structure (term, discount tiers, overage terms)?

Thanks,
Morgan
Principal SRE, OptiWare
morgan.clarke@optiware.com

Attachments: optiware_test_payload_full.jsonl

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: OptiWare — save plan options

Team — quick internal thread before we reply to OptiWare with pricing. Context: OptiWare is price-sensitive and has AtlasAI as a strong baseline. They want a committed-capacity option and performance parity. Proposed structured response: 

- Offer A (POC-focused): 6-week Dedicated POC, no term commitment, benchmarking support, $25k credit on first invoice if we hit agreed p50/p95.
- Offer B (commit + discount): 6-month reserved capacity (committed), 20% discount on usage + up to $100k onboarding credit applied across first 60 days; 2-week SLA for incident response + dedicated TAM during bake-off.
- Offer C (enterprise save): 12-month reserved, 30% discount, additional 10% marketing credit for joint case study.

We should include a hard price protection clause for the first 90 days and a fallback to hosted API (automatic) if dedicated experiences capacity issues. I recommend presenting Offer B as the primary option — it's a defensible middle ground.

Action items: 
- Marcus: prepare the technical matrix comparing p50/p95 expectation and required GPU types by Mon Feb 29.
- Neha: draft the terms and comms for Offer B and include DocuSign amendment template.
- Marissa: if we need exec-level sign-off/exception on credits, please advise.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Liu <caroline@optiware.com>, Morgan Clarke <morgan.clarke@optiware.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@optifware.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptiWare RFP v3 & benchmark schedule

Caroline / Morgan / Sam —

Appreciate the transparency. Per our internal alignment (see note from Rishi), we'd like to propose the following ahead of the kickoff on Mar 2: 

Primary proposal (Offer B) — 6-month reserved Dedicated capacity: 
- 20% discount on metered usage for committed baseline (min commit = projected steady-state tokens)
- $100k onboarding credit covering configuration, pre-warming, and benchmark validation runs
- Dedicated TAM during bake-off + prioritized incident queueing
- Price protection for first 90 days after go-live

We will share a side-by-side performance report from the dedicated POC vs our hosted fleet during the bake-off. Agenda for kickoff (30 min): 1) metrics and success criteria, 2) test profiles and schedule, 3) legal/commercial outline and timing for amendment.

Links: Drive folder with proposed benchmark plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OptiWare-Bakeoff
DocuSign amendment (preview): https://www.docusign.net/link/XYZ123

Please confirm availability for Mar 2 at 10:00 AM PT or suggest an alternate. If procurement needs an updated preliminary quote, I'll share RW_proposal_OptiWare_v2.pdf in the next email.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Liu <caroline@optiware.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Morgan Clarke <morgan.clarke@optIware.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@optifware.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptiWare RFP v3 & benchmark schedule — executive note

Caroline / Morgan / Sam —

I wanted to add a short executive note to underscore how important OptiWare is to Redwood. We're prepared to make a one-time account-specific accommodation to keep this relationship on Redwood infrastructure. Final offer (to make the trade-off vs AtlasAI clear):

- 3-month price lock at the proposed committed rate if you sign the 6-month reserved agreement by Mar 15
- Additional $50k win-back credit applied to month 2 invoice (on top of the $100k onboarding) if you choose Offer B
- SLA commitment during the bake-off and a dedicated engineer to shadow your benchmark runs

I'll ask Legal to pre-populate a short amendment and have DocuSign ready. Neha — please send the cleaned proposal and I'll approve the credits. Caroline — we value the partnership and want to make it straightforward for Procurement to move without risking reliability.

Warm regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
